description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the Popularity of different knowledge categories across three language models under three specific accuracy and answer conditions. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Movies", "Songs", and "Basketball", arranged from left to right. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Popularity", using a linear scale that ranges from 20 to 220 with tick marks at regular intervals of 40 units. The chart features grouped bars where each main category contains nine bars, subdivided into three groups of three based on the language model, indicated by color: Llama3 in blue, Qwen2 in red, and ChatGPT in yellow. Within each color group, the three bars represent different conditions indicated by patterns: a dotted pattern for "Acc=0 & GT Ans", a diagonal striped pattern for "Acc=0 & Gene Ans", and a solid fill for "Acc=1 & GT Ans". The bars vary significantly in height across the categories. The shortest bars are found in the "Movies" category, with values hovering around 28 to 48, such as the dotted yellow bar for ChatGPT at approximately 28. The tallest bars are located in the "Basketball" category, peaking with the solid red bar for Qwen2 at approximately 212. In the "Songs" category, values range moderately from roughly 48 for the dotted yellow ChatGPT bar to about 86 for the solid red Qwen2 bar. The categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted alphabetically, and there are no specific bars visually emphasized beyond the standard color and pattern coding defined in the legend.
